title: Broaden the public health goal toward health-system resilience
requirements:
- Reframe the goal toward health-system resilience, distinguishing surveillance from preparedness, response and recovery
- Frame the goal across health promotion, prevention, protection and surveillance
- Add a layered-view example of an operational population-level intervention such as a campaign
- Decompose surveillance capabilities; separate aggregate and case-level; add laboratory and One Health sources
- Note that surveillance and response tooling serves other public health challenges
- Make identity linkage conditional and bound emergency powers with oversight and time limits
- Mention AI/ML for signal detection and risk stratification
- Add response, logistics and workforce mobilisation dependencies, cross-border requirements and maturity sequencing
